answer: Because the ocean audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the opal bond on all of them and exposing each to the ember slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 3 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A 280 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
